reason: Existing execute discards accumulated sanitized process evidence if a post-run MetadataError rejects admission; the existing C31 failure does not identify whether the initial or final receipt check failed.
contracts: Initial and final receipt rejections carry explicit stage names.
Only already-sanitized compile/link/native process records and anonymous object/executable hashes and sizes are retained.
Generated source, commands, raw diagnostics and case verdicts are not copied into rejection evidence.
The existing failure status, nonzero exit code and no_runtime_verdict_accepted remain unchanged.
Exception propagation and descriptor cleanup remain unchanged.
No source or execution success is inferred for the earlier failure.
remaining: Separate independent source review is required; this patch does not block the ctime comparison fix.
